primary.notes: Subsidiaries (s1s1, s1s2, etc) attached to the first subsidiary (s1) on pendants 2, 24, 135, 157, 179, and 201 are attached in a non-standard way.  They are looped around both the pendant and the subsidiary (s1) to which they are connected.

cords.name: p1
cords.notes: The twisted ends of the main cord and the first cord are linked together.  Cord 1 is shorter than the other pendants and bound with thread at its end.
